घोर: Ghora nt.: Name of a missile. One of the eight missiles known to Arjuna 5. 94. 38-40; for the effects produced by it see Akṣisaṃtarjana.
घटोत्कचवध: Ghaṭotkacavadha m.: Name of the 70th पर्वन् in the list of a hundred sub-पर्वन्स् of the Bhārata supposed to have been made by Vyāsa in the Parvasaṃgraha 1. 2. 57. Ghaṭotkaca's death referred to in the list of the contents of the Droṇaparvan 1. 2. 164; referred to in Dhṛtarāṣṭra's summary of the incidents made for Saṃjaya 1. 1. 141-142; related to the incidents narrated in the अध्यायस् 7. 122-154.
घोषयात्रा: Ghoṣayātrā f.: Name of the 39th पर्वन् in the list of a hundred sub-पर्वन्स् of the Bhārata supposed to have been made by Vyāsa in the Parvasaṃgraha 1. 2. 46, 33, 70. Mentioned in the list of the contents of the Āraṇyakaparvan (in this sub-पर्वन् Arjuna fought with the Gandharvas) 1. 2. 122; referred to in Dhṛtarāṣṭra's summary of the incidents made for Saṃjaya 1. 1. 112; also cf. 5. 23. 25; 5. 48. 39; 5. 136. 8; 5. 155. 25; 7. 160. 17; it is related to the incidents narrated in the अध्यायस् 3. 225-243.
घर्मसागर: Gharmasāgara m.: Name of an ocean. One of the oceans, listed by Saṃjaya, to the north of the Bhāratavarṣa 6. 13. 2.
घृतवती: Ghṛtavatī f.: Name of a river. One of the rivers of the Bhāratavarṣa; its water used by people for drinking 6. 10. 22, 13; all these rivers are said to be mothers of the universe and very strong 6. 10. 35 (for citation see Atikṛṣṇā).
घृतसमुद्र: *Ghṛtasamudra m.: Name of an ocean. One of the oceans, listed by Saṃjaya, to the north of the Bhāratavarṣa whose water is घृत (घृततोयः समुद्रो ऽत्र) 6. 13. 2.
